name: libmpv (mpv, FFmpeg, libplacebo and others)
description: The mpv player library with FFmpeg, libplacebo, dav1d, libass, FreeType, HarfBuzz, FriBidi, fontconfig, libunibreak, libxml2, Lua, mbedtls and curl, built for Android by midasvo/libmpv-android. Together they are distributed under the GPL-3.0-or-later; each component's own licence is listed in the project README. The complete corresponding source of every build is attached to its release: https://github.com/midasvo/libmpv-android/releases
